status: written before any chart was checked or any system scored (2026-10-19); never changed after a system is scored
source: stage 0a plan, D11 (copied verbatim); implementation details pinned below before any chart was checked

audio.input: the item's seeded Demucs vocal stem (OUT/stems/<item>/vocals.wav)

pitch_tracker.model: CREPE full, torchcrepe 0.0.24 weights, through ONNX (crepe-full.onnx sha256 26f8366666fd9831d92fb168a9652fc89cffa1b0b2af73fd5ed974b20f1939bf)
pitch_tracker.decoder: Viterbi (torchcrepe's transition, librosa's algorithm); no dither

voiced_frame.periodicity_median_edges: at the first and last frame, the lower of the two available values (torchcrepe.filter.median)
voiced_frame.rms_rule: frame RMS >= p95(frame RMS over the whole stem) * 10^(-40/20)

pitch_window.rule: [onset + 0.2 d, offset - 0.1 d], or the whole note if d < 0.05 s (d = offset - onset)
pitch_window.frames: frames whose centre (t * 10 ms) lies inside the window, ends included

pitch_pass.rule: circular pitch-class distance between the chart pitch and the median MIDI pitch of the window's voiced frames <= 0.50 semitone

flux.stft: 1024-sample Hann window, hop 160 at 16 kHz, frames centred at t * 10 ms (zero-padded by 512)
flux.flux: sum over bins of max(0, L[t] - L[t-1]), divided by its 99th percentile
flux.peak: a local maximum within +-3 frames and >= median(+-25 frames) + 0.10
flux.min_gap_rule: of two peaks closer than 30 ms the higher is kept

voicing.rule: a voiced frame after at least 3 unvoiced frames (frames before the start count as unvoiced)

pitch_change.rule: |median of the next 5 voiced frames - median of the previous 5| >= 0.75 semitone; one time per run of such frames: the middle of the frames where the change is largest

onset_pass.rule: any evidence (flux, voicing or pitch change) within +-100 ms of the chart onset

note_verdict.rule: a note is kept only if its pitch and its onset both pass; otherwise it is masked with one reason

song_drop.rule: a song is dropped if more than 50% of its pitched notes are masked

reported_never_used_to_correct: each song's median signed offset: chart onset minus the nearest onset evidence, over its pitched notes
each song's masked share by reason
never: no shift, octave change or note edit is ever applied to a chart
sensitivity_analysis: the karaoke sets are also scored with freestyle masks only (no QA masks), pre-registered; the QA reads the same Demucs stems Copyist uses, so the unmasked score bounds that bias
